Tanaka & Oyelaran LLP"},{"spec_id":"spec_0793","text":"Subject: Nutmeg 2.0 – Wrap Review (Tues 10am... your 10am, not mine, apparently)

Hi all,

I'm setting up a 45-minute review of last week's location shoot, since it seems a few of us remember it very differently.

For anyone who missed the many messages: we lost most of Day 3 because the generator truck showed up at the wrong lot, and the permit window closed before we got set up. The permit was emailed to the full list twice. I'll just leave that there.

The rough plan:
- Timeline of Day 3 (I'll walk through it. I already have it written up and will attach it.)
- Revised call sheet process going forward (Wes is circulating the new template.)
- Updated vendor contact list (Priya)
- Reminder of who confirms transport (it's Vikram now, effective immediately)

All 10 of you are invited: Wes, Priya, Imani, Vikram, Beth, Wen, plus the AD team and both PAs.

Time: Tuesday 10:00am. To be clear, that's 10am PACIFIC. Last time I said 10am, half the team joined from the London edit suite at their 10am and sat in an empty call for eight hours, give or take. Imani and Wen, that's 6pm for you. I realize that isn't ideal, but it's the only slot that works for everyone else.

I'll present everything above and take questions at the end, assuming there are any after you've actually read the attachment. Please do read it. It's four pages.

Thanks so much,
Hana
